description: The workspace at a glance: the site, the plan as its amounts and what's left this month (a plan has amounts, no package name), each of Sightkick's jobs (auto, manual, off) and sightkickPages (scheduled: Sightkick plans its pages on the schedule and they go live on their day, unscheduled: written, they wait without a day), the warm-up, what setup still lacks, the connections, and whatsNew: the events and Sightkick's own work since this agent's last session, with a cursor. contentEnabled false means no plan is running: reads work, the rest waits for the plan, which the person starts with their card (get_settings plan gives the link). A job's setting only says what Sightkick does by itself: you can act on any job at any time. connection says what this connection may do (an API key's permissions).

since.description: whatsNew.cursor from an earlier call, or an ISO time. Left out: since this agent's last session, the same for every call in it
